sources.notes: Actual concept inspected: retain crooked jagged elongated slit, encrusted interrupted lip, terminal fissures. Reject excessive ornamental rubble/bead ring and overly symmetrical long basin; use one narrow irregular twisting fissure with unequal branching crack extension, deep angular walls and no water. One closed integral rock/cavity mesh; crust patches are assigned face regions with genuine displaced rough relief, not copied overlapping crust cards or coplanar surfaces. Broad muted mineral patches follow fractures, not a circular rim. No gas particles/steam geometries.
